public/assets/base/interior-front.png.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for a 2D cutaway survival game.
Primary request: ONE coherent 3-column by 3-row atlas, 1536x1536 pixels, 512x512 equal cells, with NINE isolated furniture/decor sprites. This is an atlas image, not a scene. Transparent background with genuine alpha; absolutely no background panels or labels or grid lines.
Style reference: Image 1 supplies the hand-painted detailed illustrated treatment, outlines and realistic worn materials of our approved developer character. Do not include or modify the character. Image 2 supplies ONLY the straight-on cutaway camera and weathered abandoned-house atmosphere, not exact objects.
Camera for EVERY sprite: strict FRONT ELEVATION facing the viewer, horizontal fronts perfectly level, verticals perfectly vertical. NO isometric, NO three-quarter view, NO skew, NO visible large side panel. At most a tiny thin top lip. Front silhouettes with subtle painted dimensional shading.
Layout reading order, one object centered in each cell, entire object contained in its cell with at least 45px transparent padding:
row 1: battered dark wood two-door wardrobe; a weathered carpenter workbench viewed straight at its long front with vise and a few tools; an old enamel kitchen sink in a faded muted teal two-door base cabinet.
row 2: a low narrow iron bed seen along its long side, rumpled gray blanket and pillow, headboard on the left; a portable rusty diesel generator inside a rectangular steel cage seen at its long front; a pair of old stacked wooden supply crates, one open lid.
row 3: a cast iron radiator with thin horizontal wall pipe and chipped paint; a small low pile of loose timber offcuts and chipped bricks (wide low silhouette); a short broken wooden balustrade segment with four slender balusters, max knee-high relative to furniture.
Mood: quiet abandoned Russian house after war, charcoal, gray olive, dusty walnut, rust accents, restrained desaturated teal. Intricate scratches, flaking paint, fabric folds, carved wood, visible joinery. Soft neutral diffuse light from above, NO luminous glow, no strong baked directional shadows, NO floor or cast shadow. Objects must be sharp, beautifully painted with readable shapes at gameplay size. Distinct items never touch neighboring cells.
public/assets/base/interior-front.png.backgroundEdit: Edit target: the attached furniture atlas. Change ONLY the background. Replace the entire gray/white checker pattern with a perfectly flat uniform vivid GREEN #00FF00 chroma-key background. This is a technical game sprite sheet that will be keyed by the renderer. Fill all spaces between furniture legs and railing balusters with exactly the same pure #00FF00 green. Preserve all nine objects, their shapes, material colors, painted details, positions, sizes and 1254x1254 layout EXACTLY. No gradients, no pattern, no gray or white grid, no shadows on the green. The background must be one single pure green color RGB(0,255,0). Do not make the furniture green.
public/assets/base/interior-front.png.format: Generated RGB PNG, green matte decoded in BaseAssets.keyedTexture at load time; source pixels unchanged on disk.

public/assets/base/crates-front.png.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent PNG furniture sprite for a 2D side-scrolling cutaway game. Create a stack of TWO weathered wooden supply boxes with an OPEN lid on the upper box. STRICT FRONT ELEVATION, camera at center, both boxes face directly forward, fronts perfectly horizontal, perfectly rectangular and symmetrical. NO angled view, NO visible side face, no isometric perspective. The lid opens upward behind the upper box and also faces directly toward camera. A few small metal cans and rumpled cloth visible inside. Match the detailed hand-painted outlined scratched wooden furniture treatment of reference image 1. Single isolated stack centered, fill 80% of the canvas, entire silhouette inside frame. TRANSPARENT background with true alpha, NO floor, no cast shadow, no text. Muted walnut and charcoal, fine worn grain, chipped edges, rusty corner brackets and front recessed handles. This replaces the angled crates from the reference with a correctly front-facing sprite.
public/assets/base/crates-front.png.format: Generated RGBA PNG, original alpha preserved.
